description: This file defines a Response class used for formatting API responses in JSON, including methods for formatting data and errors, and containing constants for content type headers. It appears to be part of an API version 2 implementation within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class for managing API response formatting, including JSON encoding of data, metadata, and relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing data, metadata, and relationships for the response.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the JSON encoded string of the response data.

methods.name: formatData
methods.description: Returns the JSON encoded string containing data, meta, and rels arrays.

methods.name: formatError
methods.description: Static method to JSON encode an error object or message for API responses.
